name: AI Support Triage & Urgent Escalation Sentinel (Production)

parameters.text:
=You are an expert Enterprise Technical Support & Customer Experience Architect.

Analyze this inbound customer ticket:
- Ticket ID: {{ $json.ticketId }}
- Customer: {{ $json.customerEmail }} (Plan: {{ $json.tier }})
- Subject: {{ $json.subject }}
- Message: "{{ $json.description }}"

Produce a JSON response strictly following this structure:
{
  "urgencyScore": <number 1 to 5, where 5 is critical outage or high churn risk>,
  "sentiment": <"POSITIVE" | "NEUTRAL" | "FRUSTRATED" | "SEVERELY_ANGRY">,
  "category": <"BILLING" | "BUG_OUTAGE" | "FEATURE_REQUEST" | "ACCOUNT_ACCESS">,
  "executiveSummary": <1 concise sentence of the customer problem>,
  "suggestedResolutionDraft": <polite, highly specific 3-paragraph reply resolving the query or giving next diagnostic steps>,
  "requiresImmediateEscalation": <true if urgencyScore >= 4 or plan is ENTERPRISE or sentiment is SEVERELY_ANGRY>
}

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "text": "🚨 *URGENT SUPPORT ESCALATION: Ticket #" + $json.ticketId + "*
*Customer:* " + $json.customerEmail + " (" + $json.tier + ")
*Subject:* " + $json.subject + "
*Sentiment:* `" + $json.response.sentiment + "` (Urgency: " + $json.response.urgencyScore + "/5)
*Summary:* " + $json.response.executiveSummary + "
*Drafted Reply Ready for 1-Click Review in Helpdesk.*"
}
